name: Header 72
definition: Set of characteristics related to the protocol.

MessageFunction.name: Message Function
MessageFunction.definition: Identifies the type of process related to the message.

ProtocolVersion.name: Protocol Version
ProtocolVersion.definition: Version of the acquirer to issuer protocol specifications.

ExchangeIdentification.name: Exchange Identification
ExchangeIdentification.definition: Unique identification of an exchange of messages between two parties.

ReTransmissionCounter.name: Re Transmission Counter
ReTransmissionCounter.definition: Number of retransmission of the message. Incremented by one for each retransmission.

CreationDateTime.name: Creation Date Time
CreationDateTime.definition: Date and time at which the message was sent.

CollectionIdentification.name: Collection Identification
CollectionIdentification.definition: Identification of the collection to which the batch belongs.

BatchIdentification.name: Batch Identification
BatchIdentification.definition: Identification of the batch to which the message belongs.

MessageSequenceNumber.name: Message Sequence Number
MessageSequenceNumber.definition: Sequence number of the message inside the batch.

MessageChecksumInputValue.name: Message Checksum Input Value
MessageChecksumInputValue.definition: Value of the message to use for the computation of the checksum of the batch or collection of messages.

InitiatingPartyIdentification.name: Initiating Party Identification
InitiatingPartyIdentification.definition: Unique identification of the partner that has initiated the exchange.

RecipientPartyIdentification.name: Recipient Party Identification
RecipientPartyIdentification.definition: Unique identification of the partner that is the recipient of the message exchange.

TraceData.name: Trace Data
TraceData.definition: Information sent in the request message to be returned in the response one, for instance to help in the retrieval of the context of the exchange.
